run_standalone_game_loop: run the Standalone game loop that updates AI4Animation each frame until the window closes
create_standalone_instance: create a Standalone instance that initializes the camera, render pipeline, ground, walls, and video recorder
set_framerate: set the target framerate for the raylib window using SetFramerate with 0 for unlimited
create_skinned_mesh: create a skinned mesh from an actor and GLB file using CreateSkinnedMesh
convert_to_screen_coords: convert normalized coordinates to screen pixel coordinates using ToScreen
